title: Let useful instances finish early while preserving the declared generic cap
statement: The compact-sphere bound gives intrinsic kappa_*>=1/(16d^2), which still yields generic k^4 after substitution. A finite geometric schedule uses fresh validation at each reached stage and only one quantum anchor bank after acceptance; rejection runs the generic learner on fresh calls. The predecision record-distance debit transfers ideal early-completion probability to actual controls without double-charging final error.

requires: Stationary/reset physical source, known k-dimensional receiver basis and fixed four-real-coordinate isometric encoder family
Actual ordinary six-state loss preparation, fresh pilot/validation/anchor/fallback chronology and finite physical full-CPTP optimization/control
All worst-case call/control/bit caps and whole-process/predecision-record implementation allowances fixed before data
provides: A parameter-free instance-sensitive acquisition path and honest all-source fallback
assumptions: High-probability actual calls, worst-case deterministic cap and expected stopping costs are distinct
Generic sources need not accept fast
The full worst-case horizon determines precision, not the observed early exit
costs: Generic deterministic cap O_tilde(k^4/(gamma epsilon)); well-balanced exact-row high-probability actual bill O_tilde((d+dr)/(kappa_* gamma epsilon))
Paid collective quantum bank, classical rational anchor search, up to 3d learned kernel settings per stage, one actual accepted anchor bank and fresh fallback calls
contract.units: Bell loss/global Bell-test failure and averaged half-diamond or permitted strategy distance only where the source supplies that conversion. Block calls, total qubit traffic, bits, controls, routing and memory are separate.
contract.obstruction: A favorable subclass rate or uncharged decision-record error can conceal the true reserved resources.

body: This is not a generic k^2 deterministic cap, unknown-basis acquisition or a retained-source-memory theorem. A random output frame need not preserve actual row geometry. Resource-event probabilities require the separately bound predecision record-retaining implementation debit inside the whole-process budget. A supplied-tail oracle extension is separate from actual residual validation and does not acquire its tail for free. No end-to-end quantum bank/production optimizer/hardware run or practical advantage is established. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
